key_features: NEW ECO FRIENDLY MATERIAL: The upgraded Gruper Yoga mat is made with premium friendly material. It costs more to make, but it is safer and more soft than traditional non-green PVC and EVA yoga mats.The exercise mats are suitable for many forms of Yoga, Pilates and fitness.

UPGRADED ANTI-SKID DESIGN AND DOUBLE LAYER ANTI TEAR: Special sticky non slip texture on both sides , more Hard-wearing than regular yoga mats and resistant to tearing and deformation. Double layer structure coupled with a non-slip textured surface provides optimal grip without sacrificing comfort.
TWO DIFFERENT SIZE OTPTIONAL : ①☛ Standard Size:72"(183cm) x 24" (61cm); Thickness: 0.24"(6mm); Weight: 2.6lb. ②☛ Thickened Size:72"(183cm) x 24" (61cm); Thickness: 0.32"(8mm); Weight: 3.1lb.

CARE INSTRUCTIONS: 1.Clean with damp cloth (cold water) or mild detergent, dry flat. 2.Do not use a washing machine or dryer or exposed to the sun for extended periods of time. 3.Designed for barefoot exercise. Your shoes or your pets' paws may tear the mat.
FREE CARRY STRAP & STORAGE BAG - No need to go buy a yoga carrying strap and bag. Easy to carry your yoga mat around with.you can carry to the gym or anywhere you want
